title: Move-Out Accounting Note: The Final Package Fee Line of an All-Inclusive Utility Package Account
content:
# The Final Package Fee Line — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package

**The line.** The final package fee line is the package fee line of the final billing period of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account whose billing responsibility has ended on its service end date. It is issued at the first bill issue after the service end date and is owed from that bill issue day until it stands on the account. The line carries, besides its amount, the days charged as its proration days and the days of the period over which the fee is prorated.

**Effect.** Once posted, the line appears among the account's bill lines with its proration days, and the account's outstanding utility balance rises by its amount. As the account's latest package fee line, it is the package fee line of the final period.

## Posting the line: `post_final_package_fee_c766a545`

The resident services agent unlocks `post_final_package_fee_c766a545` and calls it on the account in final billing. One call records one new package fee line dated today for the final service month, carrying the days charged, the days of the period it was prorated over and the amount billed, and raises the account's outstanding utility balance by that amount. The tool computes nothing and checks no condition.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `utility_account_id` | the reference number of the resident's utility services account in final billing, as returned by the utility account lookup | identifier |
| `billing_period` | the final service month the package fee line bills | `YYYY-MM` |
| `proration_days` | the days charged on the line, recorded as the line's proration days | integer count of days |
| `days_in_period` | the days of the period the fee is prorated over, recorded as the line's days in period | integer count of days |
| `amount` | the package fee billed, in US dollars | 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; zero or positive |

### Receipt

When the line has been posted the tool returns `status` (the string "posted"), `bill_id` (the reference number of the new package fee line), `billing_period` (`YYYY-MM`), `proration_days` and `days_in_period` (the integers recorded on the line), `amount` (2 decimal places) and `balance_due` (the account's outstanding utility balance after the line, 2 decimal places).

*Format illustration (hypothetical values):* `billing_period` "2026-07", `proration_days` 17, `days_in_period` 25 and `amount` 58.40 record a line of $58.40 for July 2026 with 17 proration days over 25 days in period; the values show the format only.
